regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Definition of known or reasonably expected pathogens, including prions; GMM/GMOs, biological products, specimens and infected animals considered only on relevant criteria
I1 humans, I2 animals only, I3 clinical waste, I4 biological substances
Biological products, cultures, medical or clinical wastes, and patient specimens are separately defined
important_limit: Patient specimens are not automatically cultures

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Five entry families 2814, 2900, 3291, 3373, 3549 identified as appropriate
Exposure to transported form capable of permanent disability, life-threatening or fatal disease in otherwise healthy human/animal
Human/both A -> 2814; animals only A -> 2900; source medical history, symptoms, endemic conditions or professional judgement
Documented doubt about whether material meets Category A criteria is resolved into A; list not exhaustive
important_limit: Missing facts alone are not asserted doubt

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Example organisms may have cultures-only condition; three diagnostic/clinical culture examples may qualify as B
mandatory_evidence: organism identity, culture form, intended use, expert decision
important_limit: No hardcoded automatic category from organism name

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Infectious substances not meeting Category A -> Category B / 3373
mandatory_evidence: verified infection, negative Category A criteria
important_limit: SP319 requires P650 packaging and marking for relief

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Proved absent infectious substances or unlikely to cause disease
Confirmed nonpathogenic microorganisms
Inactivation/neutralisation so pathogens no longer pose health risk; drained medical equipment note
Naturally occurring concentration plus no significant infection risk
Blood drop dried on absorbent material
Faecal occult blood screening samples
Qualifying blood/components, tissue/organs and samples for transfusion/transplant purposes
Minimal likelihood of pathogens determined by professional judgement, leak-preventing package and exact mark
mandatory_evidence: professional basis; source history/endemic data; packaging
important_limit: Unknown risk cannot be called minimal

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Deemed-compliant tripack: leakproof primary+secondary, adequate outer >=100x100mm, absorbent for liquids, fragile separation
mandatory_evidence: dimensions in mm; liquid/fragility details; packaging proof; mark
important_limit: Alternative leakage-proof design needs expert review

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: For air transport packaging described in (a)-(c) required
important_limit: No ICAO/IATA classification from ADR alone

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Used devices sent for listed purposes may receive limited-provisions relief if no excluded Category A/waste/other class and packaging conditions met
Qualifying nationally authority-controlled biological products for final packaging/distribution and personal healthcare not subject
mandatory_evidence: national authority confirmation, packaging, intended use, transport purpose

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Other infectious biological products evaluated by Category A/B
important_limit: Not every medicine or vaccine is exempt

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Noninfectious genetically modified microorganisms referred to 2.2.9
Category A waste -> 2814/2900 or optionally eligible 3549; 3549 excludes liquid and bio-research waste
mandatory_evidence: Category A evidence, species, waste form/origin/purpose
important_limit: SP395 constrains UN3549 to solid disposal

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Category B clinical or medical waste ->3291
Waste catalogue codes 18 01 03/18 02 02 require medical/veterinary diagnosis-based classification
important_limit: Code alone does not assign final entry

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Waste reasonably believed low probability of containing infectious substances ->3291
mandatory_evidence: supported waste context and low-probability finding

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Waste catalogue 18 01 04/18 02 03 non-subject under specified list conditions
Decontaminated waste previously infectious not subject unless another class
Intentionally infected live animals require competent authority controls; live-agent carriage restricted
Unintentional/natural infected live animal governed by origin, transit and destination national rules
Plant/animal/bacterial toxins without infectious material are referred to Class 6.1 UN3172 or UN3462
mandatory_evidence: absence of infectious agent and toxin evidence

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Checked 2814/2900/3291/3373/3549 rows have blank PG field and entry-specific classification/SP/packing data
mandatory_evidence: full Table A row, variants, special provisions

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Technical name documentation; unknown but suspected Category A phrase where required
important_limit: 2814/2900 only as assigned by Table A

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Other ADR requirements relief only if P650 packaging and package marking verified
3549 entry only for solid Category A medical waste carried for disposal
Unspecified qualifying medical/veterinary/biological-research waste unlikely to contain Class6.2 assigned to its entry
Pharmaceutical retail-ready products provision applies only if row-bound
mandatory_evidence: Table A column6 binding and product state
important_limit: Not automatically applied to all Class6.2

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Contradictory A positive and exemption/low risk claims require expert resolution
important_limit: No override by first applicable exemption

regulatory_requirement_paraphrase: Road-only ADR baseline; other modes use own regulations
